summary: A snow weather: falling flakes, a white battlefield with wind-scoured drifts and churned mud, patchy snow on roofs, trees and the flat tops of vehicles, and thaws round fires and idling engines.
stage: Matched native bank-edge comparison and retained historical snow evidence
rationale: Paired normal and low cameras show the raised cutout lip meeting the ground after the skirt correction. Existing motion and dry meadow evidence remain useful. The pale shading band still needs work; this is not a completed art sign-off.

capture.renderer: Forward+ (Vulkan), NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090, 1600x900, off-screen window, the user's settings
capture.town: --aivai --seed=3 --mood=overcast / --mood=snow --nohud --focus-struct=town --shot-at=20; overcast from bd4f1b598ae80c6543cd4816e3f49a6ead730876, snow from this branch
capture.note: Each capture scaled to 798x448 and laid out 2x2 with OVERCAST / SNOW labels. The battle can differ slightly run to run. Compatibility renderer checked separately (--rendering-method gl_compatibility with forced vertex shading, the town and the tank close-up); not in the sheet.
capture.melt: --fixed-fps 30 -- --scenario=fire --seed=1 --mood=snow --nohud --focus=9,-6 --zoom=15 --pitch=-36 --shot-at=90, from a scratch copy whose fire scenario adds a burning wreck (variant 6 at 4,-6, given 600 s of fuel) and a stopped tank (13,-5); rendered on 51dfff0e plus the melt commit; the before/after for the pull request is the same setup from c0043fca. Compatibility checked with --rendering-method gl_compatibility (OpenGL 3.3)
capture.drifts: --fixed-fps 30 -- --scenario=fire --seed=1 --mood=snow --nohud --focus=2,15 --zoom=26 --pitch=-48 --shot-at=20, from a scratch copy whose fire scenario adds a hedgerow (4 low_wall variant 1) and a stone wall (3 low_wall variant 0) at yaw 1.178, across Fires.WIND; the pull request also shows a burning town house (--aivai --seed=3, roof at 2.6,30 lit at once) before/after

cloud_review_2026_11_18.renderer: Godot 4.7.2, Compatibility, Mesa llvmpipe software rendering, Medium, 960x540, fixed 24 fps; not a performance measurement
cloud_review_2026_11_18.dry_comparison: Same command on both refs. Full uncropped frames, stacked with revision labels. Lower 420 rows of the two raw 960x540 captures are pixel-identical; upper background fire effects differ.
validation: Full project import; lighting/terrain/visibility checks; grass stream failures=0; 19 of 20 affected integration tests pass. Breach leaves one defender fighting at 60 seconds on both this revision and untouched main.
The new drift removal test fails against the original snow_drift.gd and passes against this revision. This negative control is a regression diagnostic, not full-build validation.
Compatibility normal camera and dry close view render without SCRIPT ERROR or SHADER ERROR. Resource/RID leaks on shutdown also occur on untouched main.
Beginning, middle and end frames inspected; complete VP9 decode verified by ffmpeg and 96 frames counted by ffprobe. Exact code-commit CI 8516925: Check, Website and Changelog passed.
limitations: No hardware GPU is exposed in the cloud workspace. High-preset software attempts and Medium Forward+ did not complete usable captures.
GPU performance, full engine-thaw/tracked-slush sequences, weather/camera transitions and broader High-preset art review remain unverified. Retained older stills are historical evidence.
The bank reads as a sharp pale band in the close Compatibility view. Snowfall is subtle against the white ground. Edge treatment and readability need further art review on Forward+ hardware.

historical_inventory_refs.note: The existing town, tank, melt, drifts and overcast comparison stills predate the cloud review. Their original capture notes above are retained.

bank_edge_followup.renderer: Godot 4.7.2, Compatibility, Mesa llvmpipe software rendering, Medium, 960x540 per pane, fixed 24 fps. Capture is not a performance measurement.
bank_edge_followup.baseline_fixture: The camera-only environment-views.gd fixture from the source ref was copied into the isolated before checkout; all game code is the original before ref. Both sides use identical camera, preset/exposure, seed and simulation timing. Fire and particle variation is cosmetic.
bank_edge_followup.change: Remove the raised alpha-cut lip by burying the thin skirt. Full crest remains 0.48m. Wind stamp, ground, road, grass and snowfall shaders unchanged; drift declares the same five samplers and removes one fragment lookup. No GPU speedup claim.
validation: Full project import and three focused lighting/material checks pass.
Dry foreground lower 420 rows remains pixel-identical to the prior branch dry render, previously matched against main.
Changelog validation and presentation audit pass.

Identical captured camera matrices, simulation times and fixture hashes verified. Both captures exit 0, without script/shader errors. Existing shutdown resource leaks remain. Full VP9 decode passed; 96 frames verified; representative encoded frames inspected.
limitations: The broad pale band persists. Ground uses probe lighting and the bank does not; this is a likely contributor, not a fully isolated shading diagnosis. The shared probe helper adds three sampler declarations, so it was not added.
No hardware GPU is exposed (/dev/dri and /dev/nvidia0 absent); available Forward+ is llvmpipe software. Earlier Medium Forward+ runs did not finish usable frames. No hardware performance validation.
Long engine thaw, dark track breakthrough, wide melt context and weather transitions were not newly captured. Historical stills retain their original provenance.
Prior local breach scenario failure (one surviving defender at 60 seconds) and shutdown leaks reproduce on untouched main.

media.layout: Before left, after right; normal then low camera, 48 frames per view. Poster at 2.5 seconds.

bank_edge_followup.encode: ffmpeg: four 24fps PNG sequences, trim 48 frames each, add 40px labels, hstack before/after, concat normal then low; libvpx-vp9 -crf 31 -b:v 0 -pix_fmt yuv420p -row-mt 1
